stem: Ramesha is a previously healthy 5-month-old girl with bronchiolitis. Her work of breathing decreases with a trial of bronchodilator. Her parents ask if this means she has asthma. How would you respond?

options.text: Bronchodilator response and asthma are the same thing
Bronchodilator response is non-specific and does not equal asthma
Bronchodilator response is non-specific but predicts future asthma
Bronchodilator response means she will need daily medication
Bronchodilator response means she will grow out of asthma

explanation: A response to a bronchodilator is not diagnostic of asthma. In infants with bronchiolitis, transient improvement can occur and does not by itself establish an asthma diagnosis.

citations.title: Practice Quiz: Asthma Management: Medications and Devices - Part B

rationale: In young infants, wheeze during bronchiolitis may improve transiently with bronchodilator, but asthma is a clinical diagnosis based on a broader pattern of recurrent symptoms and variable airflow obstruction.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect. Bronchodilator response does not equal asthma.
optionExplanations.B: Correct. Bronchodilator responsiveness is non-specific and is not sufficient to diagnose asthma.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect. It does not reliably predict future asthma on its own.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect. A single bronchodilator response does not mean daily controller therapy is required.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect. This is not a valid inference from bronchodilator response.

Instructions

Question 8 - 10 relate to this case

Asthma Management: Medications and Devices - Part 4

Ramesha is a previously healthy 5 month old girl who presents to the hospital with a 3 day history of runny nose and cough. Today her parents have been concerned that she has been breathing fast and not feeding. On examination, she has a temperature of 37 degrees C, oxygen saturation of 96% on RA, moderate increased work of breathing with tachypnea, and soft wheeze throughout her chest. You diagnose her symptoms as bronchiolitis.
